items.prompt: A local C++ example prints the expected result once. What evidence and limits should accompany that claim?
items.modelAnswer: Record exact source revision/hash, compiler/version/target, language mode/flags, build diagnostics, inputs, exit status/stdout and test scope. Separate build success, runtime tests and app runner capability. Do not infer portability, safety for all inputs or financial correctness from one output.

criteria.text: Keeps untested ranges and platforms explicit.
